name: Each due dunning step is sent once and disputed items are paused
title: SC-11-04-01 Each due dunning step is sent once and disputed items are paused
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given an overdue debt and a disputed item
When dunning runs twice
Then the due step is sent once and the disputed item is paused
